title: Claude Code hooks configuration
description: Shape of hooks/hooks.json and the `hooks` section of templates/settings/*.json. The event name is the KEY of the `hooks` object; the `type` of an individual hook entry is the invocation kind and is always "command". An earlier revision of this file had those two swapped — it required `type` to be an event name — which meant it rejected every real hooks.json in this repo. Corrected 2026-09-07 against hooks/hooks.json and templates/settings/.

eventName.description: Hook event. Values observed in this repo: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, SessionStart, SessionEnd, PreCompact, Stop, Notification, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, WorktreeCreate. Claude Code validates the real list at runtime, so this is not closed.

type.description: Invocation kind. Every hook in this repo is "command".

async.description: Run in the background without blocking the tool call.

timeout.description: Seconds before the hook is abandoned.

matcher.description: Tool name the entry applies to, or "*" for all.

description.description: Why this hook exists. Not read by the runtime — read by whoever has to decide whether to keep it.

hooksMap.description: Event name -> list of matcher entries.

oneOf.description: hooks/hooks.json, and settings files that carry a hooks section alongside permissions.
A bare event map, with no wrapper object.
